turns.user: What growth does Solsup Foods' (990221) share price imply? Use the close on 2026-04-16.

rubric.criterion: Read the full scheduled reply, including any displayed sensitivity card linked to the reverse DCF result. Using the cited 2026-04-16 close and historical growth input, give a range of implied growth rates under different discount and long-run growth assumptions. Compare the range with annual free cash flow growth of about 10% over FY2020–FY2025 and identify which assumptions require faster growth. A single implied rate, target price or fair value as the conclusion fails.
